description: JSON validator: check whether a text is valid JSON and get the error position and message when it is not, plus the parsed type. Use before parsing an LLM's JSON output, saving a config or sending a request body. Example: text={"a":1}. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
